image_description: A vintage, rusted agricultural plow resting on dry, cracked earth. The implement features a heavy metal frame with two large, spoked iron wheels (cage wheels) for depth control and traction. A curved moldboard and share are visible at the bottom right, partially embedded in the soil. The background consists of blurred green vegetation.
